- scripts/claude_engine.py:640-645 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_support_lock_records` incorrectly excludes the trusted support tree when the support root is nested inside `workdir`, leaving the tree with no locked or verified files.
  WHY: In consumer repositories the walk skips all entries under `.codex-workflow-src`, so a read-profile run can modify trusted support scripts without detection before privileged workflow steps execute.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:513-514 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The SIGINT and SIGTERM trap handlers swallow `_ai_engine_support_finish` failures, so tampering detected during an interrupted run does not propagate exit code 86.
  WHY: Callers receive exit code 130 or 143 instead of 86 and may classify a tampered run as a crash or timeout.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Verify support-script integrity immediately before execution."
  expected_change_site: scripts/claude_engine.py:_support_lock_records relationship check between `workdir` and the walked `parent_path`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN's new `test_read_isolation_unsafe_support_lock_is_terminal` in tests/test_ai_engine.py covers the symlink case (which raises `EngineError` before the loop), but the consumer-case layout (`workdir == GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, `root == GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.codex-workflow-src`) is not exercised by any test in tests/test_claude_engine.py: support and workdir are always siblings there, never one inside the other; The test `test_support_lock_detects_changes_and_restores_modes` builds `workdir = scripts/audit-data` (workdir *inside* root), which is the *opposite* of the consumer layout; The workflow-level mitigation in `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml:400-407` only diffs the consumer repo against `SUPPORT_SHA`; it does not verify `.codex-workflow-src`, so the in-function bypass above is the only line of defense for the consumer's trusted-support scripts and it does not engage.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_engine.py:645 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `workdir in parent_path.parents` check also matches when `workdir` is an ancestor of `root`, causing the walk to skip every entry in the consumer repository's support tree.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: In consumer repositories, `support-lock` records 0 files, removes no chmod bits, and leaves `.codex-workflow-src` writable and unverified, allowing read-profile runs to overwrite support scripts used by privileged follow-up steps.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:513-514 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The INT and TERM trap handlers swallow `_ai_engine_support_finish` failure, so an interrupted run that detects tampering returns the signal exit code instead of 86.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: Poller callers may classify the tampered run as a crash or timeout and retry on codex rather than terminating.
